seguranca-da-informacao.title: Information Security
seguranca-da-informacao.description: Complete and advanced protection for your operation's critical data. We mitigate risks and ensure your business continuity.
seguranca-da-informacao.detailedText: In the current corporate landscape, data protection is not just a technical need, but a strategic pillar. Our Information Security solutions are based on Gartner Magic Quadrant leading technologies, offering multi-layered defense against cyber threats. From initial audit to Zero Trust access policies implementation, our team acts proactively to identify vulnerabilities and shield your infrastructure against invasions, ransomware, and data leaks.

ativos-de-rede.title: Network Assets
ativos-de-rede.description: Uninterrupted connectivity and high performance with cutting-edge equipment to support your company's growth.
ativos-de-rede.detailedText: The backbone of any modern operation is its data network. We provide and configure high availability Network Assets that ensure your communication and mission-critical systems never stop. We work with intelligent routing, high-density switching and next-generation wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi 6). Our consultancy helps to exactly dimension the equipment you need, optimizing your investment (ROI) and ensuring future scalability.

tecnologia-predial.title: Building Technology
tecnologia-predial.description: Intelligence and physical security integrated into a single ecosystem for corporate and industrial environments.
tecnologia-predial.detailedText: We transform traditional spaces into smart and highly secure environments. Our Building Technology vertical integrates all vital systems of your building: from rigorous control of who enters and leaves, to analytic video monitoring and fire alarm systems. With building automation (BMS), your company not only gains in asset security, but also in energy efficiency and centralized management, significantly reducing operational costs.

cabeamento-estruturado.title: Structured Cabling
cabeamento-estruturado.description: The high-reliability physical foundation for data, voice, and video transmission across your infrastructure.
cabeamento-estruturado.detailedText: An IT system is only as strong as its physical infrastructure. Our engineering team designs and executes Structured Cabling solutions adhering to the strictest international standards (EIA/TIA, ISO, ABNT). Whether utilizing metallic cabling (Cat6, Cat6A) or high-speed optical fiber, we ensure an organized, documented, bottleneck-free network. We deliver full Data Center setups to office horizontal cabling, certified and performance-guaranteed.

suporte-ti-empresarial.title: Enterprise IT Support
suporte-ti-empresarial.description: Comprehensive IT management and continuous consultative support ensuring maximum uptime and team productivity.
suporte-ti-empresarial.detailedText: Our Enterprise IT Support is tailor-made for corporate environments requiring high availability and rapid SLA response times. We deliver Tier 1, 2, and 3 Service Desk, proactive NOC monitoring for servers and network assets, cloud backup management, and preventive maintenance routines. We allow your staff to focus on your core business while we take care of all technological stability.
features: Specialized N1, N2 & N3 Service Desk
On-site & Remote Support with Guaranteed SLA

field-services.title: Field Services & Site Deployment
field-services.description: Technical reach and on-site expertise for seamless rollouts, store openings, and nationwide corporate branch support.
field-services.detailedText: For enterprises and retail chains with multiple branches, franchises, or industrial plants, our Field Services team delivers rapid, standardized deployments. From full store rollouts — including POS infrastructure, cabling, Wi-Fi, and CCTV cameras — to on-site technical support and swift hardware swap in the field, we are the trusted partner of leading brands like IMC Group (Pizza Hut, KFC), Bacio di Latte, and Sonda.
features: Full Store & Branch Rollout and Setup

aboutPage.title: Connecting Businesses. Protecting Your Company's Future.
aboutPage.subtitle: Three decades transforming IT infrastructure and security into real competitive advantage for corporate and government clients.
aboutPage.historyP1: Founded in 1994, Critel Tecnologia was created with the purpose of providing network engineering and infrastructure solutions with technical excellence and human commitment. Over 30 years, we established ourselves as one of Brazil's most solid partners in corporate connectivity, information security, and building technology.
aboutPage.historyP2: We work side by side with the biggest players in financial, retail, telecom, and services markets — such as Bradesco, IMC Group (Pizza Hut, KFC), Bacio di Latte, Ofner, Engemon, and Sonda IT —, executing high-complexity, mission-critical projects.
aboutPage.missionDesc: Deliver integrated IT infrastructure and security solutions ensuring maximum availability, productivity, and protection for our clients.
aboutPage.visionDesc: To be the leading benchmark in IT engineering, connectivity, and high-standard enterprise support in Brazil.
values: Continuous Innovation & Focus on Client Business

privacyPage.title: Privacy and Data Protection Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: At Critel Tecnologia, information security and data privacy are treated with the highest technical and ethical standards.
privacyPage.section1Text: Critel Tecnologia is committed to protecting the personal data of its clients, partners, and site visitors in strict compliance with data privacy regulations (LGPD).
privacyPage.section2Text: We only collect necessary information voluntarily provided through our contact forms (such as name, corporate email, company, and phone) exclusively for commercial inquiries and proposal drafting.
privacyPage.section3Text: We adopt advanced information security practices, encryption, firewalls, and restricted access controls to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or data leaks.
privacyPage.section4Text: You may request confirmation, access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time via comercial@criteltecnologia.com.br.
